SellingPrices.title: Selling prices
SellingPrices.help: The main place to set prices. Tick SKUs, then choose Manual (VND formula: supplier price + profit, converted, plus freight + affiliate) or Automatic (% margin price run). The price applies to the whole SKU; a lot is only the basis. Approved products: price + commission wait for approval before customers see them. Changing rates / costs never changes prices by itself.
SellingPrices.subtitle: Selling price, pending price and latest cost for every SKU

manualPage.title: Set prices manually
manualPage.subtitle: The price applies to the whole SKU (the lot is only the basis). Approved products: price + affiliate commission wait for approval and take effect together.
manualPage.empty: No SKU selected — go back to Selling prices and tick the SKUs to price.
manualPage.truncated: Only the first 200 SKUs are shown — select fewer.
manualPage.noRate: No exchange rate yet — add one first.
manualPage.oldRate: An older rate is selected, not the current one — double-check before saving.
manualPage.formula: Sell VND = supplier price + profit · Sell MMK = sell VND ÷ rate + freight + affiliate, rounded up to a multiple of {round} MMK.
manualPage.profitNote: The desired profit is only the mark-up on the supplier price — not the final profit: inbound / shipment costs, COD fees, returns and running costs are not deducted. The purchase price is the exact receipt selected, not an average.
manualPage.comboLot: Combo: sum of components' latest purchase prices
manualPage.mmkHelp: MMK goods keep the existing method: enter the price, affiliate commission (blank = by %) and fixed profit (used by automatic pricing). Price changes need a reason.

Warehouses.description: Each product belongs to one selling warehouse: receiving, sellable stock, order dispatch and pricing all follow it. The quarantine area holds customer returns.

modeHint.VN_IMPORT: Price = VND cost × rate × (1 + margin %) + shipping MMK/kg × weight
modeHint.LOCAL_MMK: Price = latest lot MMK cost + product's fixed profit

Unit costs round separately. Changed inputs require explicit reallocation; shipped order cost snapshots stay unchanged.

Pricing.rateHint: Enter USD → MMK and USD → VND; the MMK ↔ VND rate is calculated automatically.
Pricing.formula: Price = VND cost (latest batch) ÷ rate (VND per 1 MMK) × (1 + margin %), rounded up
Pricing.formulaVn: VN-import warehouse: VND purchase cost (latest posted receipt) × rate × (1 + margin %) + VN → MM freight (MMK/kg) × weight, rounded up. Margin applies to the purchase cost only. Combos without a declared weight use the sum of component weights.
Pricing.formulaMmk: Myanmar-purchase warehouse: price = MMK cost (the selected posted receipt, latest by default) + the product's fixed MMK profit, rounded up. Set the fixed profit on the Selling prices page (manual, MMK warehouse).
Pricing.noWeight: No weight (g), shipping cannot be priced
Pricing.noProfit: No fixed profit (MMK), cannot be priced
Pricing.noCost: No posted receipt in the right currency (combo: a component is missing), so no price can be computed
Pricing.changedSince: Price / commission changed after the preview — this line will be skipped
Pricing.applyConfirm: Apply new prices to the selected lines?
Pricing.noRate: No exchange rate yet — add one first
Pricing.costBasisHelp: Selling prices use purchase cost and add freight per kg once. Actual shipment expenses determine inventory cost and profit.

Quarantine.title: Quarantine (returned goods)
Quarantine.hint: Inspect returned goods: restock if sellable, otherwise discard.

Alerts.title: Stock alerts
Alerts.note: Stop selling below {block} days, warn below {warn} days. Sales velocity over the last {window} days, cover {cover} days after arrival. Change in Settings.
Alerts.reorderHint: Suggest = sold/day × (lead time + cover days) + safety stock − available. Goods received into the selling warehouse (including a shipment not yet marked arrived) are already in “available”; the “Stock elsewhere” column is for reference only and is not sellable until moved to the selling warehouse.

Reports.title: Reports
Reports.basis: Revenue = goods value of orders completed in the period (by completion date, Yangon time), net of returns. Profit = revenue − cost of issued lots. Shipping fees shown separately.
Reports.slow: Slow movers (in stock, no sales in {days} days)
Reports.missingCost: These orders had missing costs when shipped. Missing amounts are counted as 0, so profit may be overstated:
Reports.estimatedCost: Profit includes estimated costs captured when shipping. Orders:
Reports.recordedCostBasis: Based on order completion period and fees recorded as of viewing. {pending} COD orders await settlement. Store pays delivery on {sender} orders: only recorded fees are deducted; other unrecorded delivery costs are excluded. This is not accounting net profit.
Reports.inboundHint: Goods of these shipments are already received into the selling warehouse and counted in stock; the list only tracks shipments that have not arrived.

publishedZeroPrice.help: Customers cannot order them (blocked on the server). Price or hide the product.

missingWeight.title: VN-import variants missing weight
missingWeight.help: The price formula needs weight for the per-kg freight; pricing skips these variants.

missingWeightLocal.title: MMK-purchase variants missing weight
missingWeightLocal.help: Does not affect price; needed for VTP shipping.

badLocation.title: Products in an inactive or non-sales warehouse
badLocation.help: Their stock cannot be sold. Move the product to an active sales warehouse.

stockMissingCost.title: Lots with sellable stock but no cost
stockMissingCost.help: Orders issued from these lots record Missing cost. Allocate shipment costs or estimate the cost on the lot page.

draftOnlyCost.title: Variants with lots only from draft/cancelled receipts
draftOnlyCost.help: No posted purchase cost, so pricing skips them. Post the real receipt.

comboMissingCost.title: Combos without a computable cost
comboMissingCost.help: A component has no posted lot in the right currency, so pricing skips the combo.

oldShipRuns.title: Price runs with per-kg freight applied before the freight fix
oldShipRuns.help: Freight may have been added twice if lots had shipment costs. Review the prices; nothing is changed automatically.

lotShipmentMismatch.title: Lots re-received on a document of another shipment
lotShipmentMismatch.help: The lot keeps its old shipment, so shipment costs are allocated to the wrong place. Needs a separate fix.

overdueOrders.title: Pending orders past their hold time
overdueOrders.help: Cron will cancel them; call the customer if the order should be kept.

longShipping.title: Orders shipping for more than {days} days
longShipping.help: Check with the carrier or record delivery / return.

codExceptions.title: Collected COD that cannot be reconciled directly
codExceptions.help: Order has returns/refunds or is not completed. Handle as an exception; never guess the amount.

quarantine.title: Returned goods awaiting inspection
quarantine.help: Inspect, then restock to a sales warehouse or write off.

staleDrafts.title: Draft stock documents older than {days} days
staleDrafts.help: Post or cancel them to keep figures clear.

baseline.title: Operating baseline
baseline.help: From the status history of orders created in the period. p50 = median; p90 = 90% of orders are faster than this.
baseline.neverPriced: {count} receipt lines in the period had no price change afterwards.

Analytics.title: Shopping behavior
Analytics.basis: Sequential funnel for sessions viewing a product during the period. Only web orders linked to the same session count; login is optional. Maximum range: 90 days.
Analytics.collection: Collection started: {started} · Data on {days} days in this period
Analytics.vitalsHelp: p75 is the value that 75% of samples do not exceed. LCP/INP are in ms; CLS is unitless. Small samples are not conclusive.

CatalogImport.title: Import / update products from Excel
CatalogImport.help: One file to create products, update their details and prices, and receive stock. New products start hidden; with a price they can be submitted for approval, without one they stay as drafts. Blank cells keep the current value (including a price awaiting approval). Always preview; you can confirm only when there are no errors.
CatalogImport.rateQuote: Cost rate: 1 VND = {rate} MMK (pinned for these batches)
CatalogImport.errorsTitle: Fix these in the file before importing:
CatalogImport.confirmHelp: New products are created hidden. Stock creates DRAFT receipts per sales warehouse — open them, check, then Post.
CatalogImport.confirmBlocked: You cannot confirm while the file has errors. Fix the errors above, select the corrected file and click Preview again.
CatalogImport.priceChanges: {count} SKUs change selling price / CTV commission — price history will be recorded.
CatalogImport.pricingForbidden: The file changes selling prices / CTV commissions — this needs the pricing permission. Leave the price columns empty or ask someone with that permission.
CatalogImport.finishProducts: Back to products to add images and publish

Preorders.title: Pre-orders
Preorders.help: Orders waiting for stock, in the order they were placed. Current stock is assigned to the earliest orders first.

BatchReview.submitNowHint: Only products created or changed in this batch that are ready; the rest are listed.
BatchReview.approveNowHint: You approve (logged) the products whose only change is this batch. Products with other earlier changes are listed for a full review. New products are never published automatically.
BatchReview.needsReview: {n} product(s) were not approved now because they have other earlier changes (content, images or prices) — open them to review in full:
